standing_policy.description: Present when the server's standing cost policy admits this Run (health capability `costStandingPolicyV1`): the rule that names its route. No review is prepared and nothing is held; `POST /v1/jobs` the same request without `cost_review`. The job's admission is judged again when it runs and counted in the rule's window, so a full window or a changed project can still refuse it.
